items:
Top Reasons to Book SeaPines on 30A:

* New Luxury Home in NatureWalk at Seagrove
* Community Pool (Seasonally Heated), Hot Tub, Fire Pit, and BBQ Grilling Areas
* Fitness Center, Pickleball Courts, and Children's Playground
* FREE 6-Seater Golf Cart Included with Your Stay
* 4 Bikes Included for Guest Use
* Two Screened Porches Plus Oversized Back Patio with Gas Grill and Outdoor Fireplace
* Grayton Beach State Park Only 3.3 Miles Away
* Scenic Community Nature Trails Leading to the Beach
* Professionally Managed

Welcome to SeaPines on 30A, a luxury coastal retreat located in the highly desirable NatureWalk at Seagrove, one of 30A’s most sought-after communities. This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 4 and a half-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience—ideal for families, couples, and groups looking to experience the best of 30A. Enjoy upscale furnishings, an open-concept living area with gas fireplace and upgraded surround sound, and a fully loaded kitchen designed for effortless entertaining. Step outside to relax on one of two screened porches or gather around the outdoor fireplace on the oversized back patio. With a FREE golf cart, 4 bikes, and access to incredible resort-style amenities, getting to the beach and exploring nearby favorites like Grayton Beach State Park is a breeze.

NatureWalk offers a zero entry pool, heated lap pool, hot tub, fire pit, pickleball courts, playground, fitness stations, grilling areas, and scenic nature trails leading directly to the beach—making SeaPines on 30A the ultimate seaside getaway.

The Bed Setup:

1st Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom

1st Floor Half Bathroom

2nd Floor Guest Bedroom #1: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom

2nd Floor Guest Bedroom #2: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom

2nd Floor Guest Bedroom #3: Three Twin Beds with Ensuite Bathroom

House Rules:
* This is a NON-smoking property.
* Pets are NOT permitted on this property.

Parking:
All cars must be in the driveway. 2 cars maximum (the golf cart can be parked in the garage). No Trailers, RVs, Scooters, Boats, or Motorcycles are permitted without approval.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located by the sea, this vacation home is in Seagrove Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
